title.narrative: Share-Net Ethiopia

description.narrative: Share-Net International (SNI) is a global knowledge platform on SRHR that is organized in-country hubs. Share-Net International is currently operational in seven countries: Bangladesh, Burundi, Jordan, the Netherlands, Burkina Faso, Colombia, and Ethiopia.Share-Net Ethiopia is hosted by the Consortium of Reproductive Health Associations (CORHA). The Consortium of Reproductive Health Associations (CORHA) is a member-driven umbrella organization of 82 foreign and local NGOs/CSOs committed to the provision of comprehensive, integrated and sustainable Reproductive Health (RH) information and services in Ethiopia. Knowledge sharing, knowledge translation, knowledge promotion, and network building are the core priorities of Share-Net Ethiopia.

comment.narrative: In this reporting period Share-Net Ethiopia sponsored a master?s thesis of five students. All of the research titles are under Sexual and Reproductive Health thematic area.

To unknot the teenage pregnancy problem, multilevel and multifaceted interventional points were identified. Circumstances and environmental factors that adolescents live in, interact with and abide by were primary points of action to prevent teenage pregnancies. Personal factors, sociocultural factors, economic/financial factors, parental factors as well as legal and social factors need to be addressed through tailored, well thought, and integrated interventions.
during the reporting period seven students research and one desk review conducted

comment.narrative: Share-Net Ethiopia country hub member number is growing from day to day. Currently we have 304 from which 205 are newly registered members of this year.

Share-Net Ethiopia has over 70 organizational and over 20 individual members. Of which 4 are research centers and universities, 66 are CSOs, and 20 individual members including academicians, journalists and development practitioners.
